R1_false_alarms.rule: stack FA <= 2.5 % at 1 % total budget and worst test drive <= 5 %

R2_targets_pointdrop_intensity.rule: PointDrop >= 30 % and IntensitySpoof >= 50 % in the stack at the 1 % total budget (predicted borderline)

R3_single_return_phantoms.rule: far / budget calibrated phantoms <= FA + 10 points (physics bound); near replace reported

R4_episodes.rule: false-episode rate <= 10 % and sensor-fixed near replace >= 50 % of the episodes within 3 s; world-fixed reported (predicted not detected after the first scan)

R5_every_layer_earns_its_place.rule: each headline layer, when removed, lowers some physical-attack detection by >= 3 points (predicted: L1 does not on the single-return set)

R6_wp_file_targets.rule: WP file: 50-400 added points >= 60 % and near sparse > 50 % at 1 % FA (predicted NOT MET: physics bound)

R7_freeze_reproduces_test_scores.rule: frozen domain replayed from raw scans reproduces the stored test per-layer scores and stack score (<= 1e-9, 0 alarm differences) on all clean test scans and the attacked scans of >= 2 test drives

R8_tests_cache_cost.rule: full test suite passes, extra cache <= 2 GB, scoring cost per scan reported

V1_combiner_choice.rule: survivors of the clean-FA control: max, split

V2_density_part.rule: density part kept only if validation mean physical detection +2 points and worst LODO FA +2 points at most

milestone.verdict: PARTIAL: R2, R5, R6 NOT MET
milestone.rule: M1-LiDAR closes PARTIAL when the pre-registered predictions of the physics bound hold and every honest limit is stated
